changes.text_zh: AI 集成：多切片分析、智能结构重命名、AI 窗宽窗位、燃烧标注检测、一键生成 SR 报告

changes.text_en: DICOM Print: printer management, job submission, status tracking

changes.text_zh: 序列分析：自动分类 ADC/DWI/DCE/MG/US、DCE 期相检测、DWI b 值分析

changes.text_zh: 开发者体验：SSE 进度流、持久化设置单例、系统信息端点

changes.text_zh: 内存管理：磁盘像素存储、会话大小限制、LRU 缓存
changes.text_en: Memory management: disk-based pixel storage, session size limits, LRU caches

changes.text_zh: 安全：SSRF 防护、路径遍历防护、速率限制、API 密钥遮蔽
changes.text_en: Security: SSRF protection, path traversal prevention, rate limiting, API key masking

changes.text_zh: 性能：Cornerstone3D 代码分割、懒加载、虚拟滚动
changes.text_en: Performance: Cornerstone3D code splitting, lazy-loaded imports, virtual scrolling

changes.text_zh: 离线支持：Service Worker SHA-256 请求体哈希缓存
changes.text_en: Offline support: Service Worker SHA-256 body-hashed cache keys
